title: Stramit Corporation Pty Ltd - acquisition of Morinda Australia Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commences review under Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Stramit Corporation Pty Ltd has acquired Morinda Australia Pty Ltd, trading as Garage World and Shed Boss.  Stramit is a manufacturer and supplier of steel roll formed products and Garage World and Shed Boss provide services to the shed building and assembly industry.
body_sections.Market definition: The acquisition was considered in the context of separate markets for the supply of steel roll formed products and the supply of steel frame sheds and buildings.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC formed the view that the acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant markets due to a number of actual and potential competitors who would be likely to constrain Stramit from attempting to exercise market power.
